1.content: F cells are traversable free spaces; H cells are static hazards that cannot be entered; S marks the start location; G marks the goal location.

2.content: A reward of 1 is granted only when the agent moves onto the G (goal) cell, which also terminates the episode; all other moves yield a reward of 0.

3.content: Actions are deterministic: executing move_up/down/left/right shifts the agent exactly one cell in that direction unless the target cell is a static hazard (H) or outside the grid, in which case the move is invalid.

4.content: The grid layout of cell types (F, H, S, G) remains constant throughout an episode; there are no dynamic or moving objects.

5.content: All cell types and agent actions behave deterministically; there are no stochastic transitions or moving objects.
